title: [E-Documents] Remove the PDF reader service credit memo upgrade
summary: Removed an unused upgrade procedure and internal helper method for the PDF reader e-document service that was not referenced by any active workflow.
key_points: Deletes UpgradePDFReaderServiceCreditMemo procedure and its upgrade tag registration
Removes GetPDFReaderServiceCode helper method that only the deleted upgrade used
The GetPDFReaderService method still adds credit memo support when creating the service
Affects only cleanup of obsolete upgrade code with no behavior change to active flows
quote: Only removes an upgrade step and an internal procedure used by it. No schema or behavior change for any active flow.
